feedback: Reed's confession follows the existing signed deletion, his final denial, knowledge of the original contents, and his admitted visit beside the waiting glass. It confirms the physical actions of taking poison during the preview and adding it later, but those actions were the inference the accusation already required rather than a new hidden mechanism. His desire to control the written version fits the doctoral grievance and caption editing, making the motive feel earned. The final name-on-the-work reversal is effective and restrained. Hugh and Chip's admissions preserve consequences for nonmurderous misconduct, though their tidy remorse slightly extends the shared reflective cadence of the previous round.
